purpose: Manually observed BB3 labels paired with sanitized raw numeric extracts. Research evidence only; not proof of complete rule support.

source.privacy: Source filename, coach/team/player names, dates, account identifiers and arbitrary text omitted.

capture.method: Existing saved replay loaded into BB3 and stepped with Computer Use. This is not a newly generated hotseat replay.
capture.screenshots: Inspected inline in tool history; no screenshot files exported. Manual transcription is reviewable by replaying the hashed local source.
capture.locatorConvention: One-based EventExecuteSequence; zero-based StepResult and message array indices. UI team turns are cumulative 1-16.

limits: One source and one replay version; cross-source and version-held-out acceptance still required.
